status: PROPOSED. Addendum for game/data/dialogue/companion.json. Nothing here is live.
voice: Sentence case and first person singular, as the 150 live lines. Capitals only for what the set records or receives. It knows only what it has witnessed. Its words make nothing happen.

silence_rule: Nothing unsolicited during grief, a protected conversation, a typed draft, a pause or the ending. After a release slip, or either memorial, no joke of any kind until the player types one first.
